summary: ADR-0048 accepted 2026-07-26; repository source and accepted ADRs are authoritative, projections/indexes derived cache only; deterministic locator returns locations, hashes, provenance, ranking evidence, confidence, never synthesized facts; callers reread and hash-verify; trusted adapters constrain domain/path/snapshot/budget/confidence, LLM intent cannot widen; VDD records post-reread decisions, rejected candidates and uncovered required modules block readiness; Quick Dev uses only VDD-frozen decisions; Bootstrap Review freezes context in Artifact View; no post-freeze expansion; ambiguity fallback off unless approved, then only _llm_backend.py::run_llm_exec; maintenance pins local main without fetch/checkout/merge/branch mutation and writes derived artifacts plus append-only evidence; extends ADR-0044, complements ADR-0037/0041/0043, supersedes none; fail closed on missing/stale/low-confidence/out-of-policy/hash drift; no authorization for routes, Hosted E2, live metadata, deployment, acceptance, handoff, release, or commit
